name: Himeka
source:
Deity enshrined in local shrine. Even though she looks like a child, she is more than 100 years old.

By saving Akito she loses most of her power and needs to stay at Akito's house in order to regain it. Immature and somewhat depending, she wants Akito's attention and always fights with Koharu. She however becomes dutiful when it comes to her followers.

She doesn't rememeber her past and her song seems to have mysterious power.
